title: 2 Side by Side homes with Dual Rooftops hot tubs!
description:
The ultimate high-capacity Nashville experience! This premier Duo listing combines two designer homes (Units 12 & 13) located side-by-side to provide 10 bedrooms, 10 full bathrooms, and 2 massive rooftops. Perfectly situated 5 minutes from Broadway, this setup allows your group of up to 28 guests to stay together while maintaining the luxury of private bedrooms and "get-ready" space.

The space
Unit 12 & Unit 13 Side-by-Side:

10 Bedrooms total: All rooms feature high-end linens and designer decor.

10 Full Bathrooms: Essential for large groups getting ready for a night on the town.

Dual Rooftops: Ample outdoor space for the whole group to gather and toast to the trip.

Parking: On-site parking for multiple vehicles—a major perk in the downtown area.

Other things to note
We’d love to host you, whether you’re visiting for a single night, a month, or even up to six months. At BetterBNB, our mission is to provide a clean, comfortable, and welcoming home where every guest feels cared for.

Your safety and comfort are our top priorities. We take pride in creating a space where you can relax, recharge, and feel at ease during your time in Nashville. Thank you for trusting us with your stay—we look forward to making your experience smooth, stress-free, and memorable.
